investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Stratpath Mobility (ride-hailing); Platform: on-premises data center DC-South, server range 172.25.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster stratp-prod (kubeadm); Ceph cluster providing block storage to a KVM virtual machine platform; one top-of-rack switch pair per rack; network work uses NET- identifiers; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
